note: 06:00 UTC: line A with the colour map (my call so far: map on, half its light out). Storm now wound fibres round a lower eye. The dark field is the open point: boulders (w15), teeth (w16), satin rolls (w17). Next: shorter rolls with lumpy crests.

looks.label: w17 at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: long rolls along the flow carry the dark field, tops only on their crests (too weak to see here). Reads as flowing satin with strata, not cloud yet. Line (i) 17.686
w16 at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: softer skin, pointed tops, bright painted rims cut. Dark field reads as teeth; too soft, band line red. Refused.
w15 at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: tops only where the field is over a threshold, flat deck between. Dark field reads as boulders, not cloud. Line (i) 18.711

w14 at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: map with half its light taken out, no tops inside the storm. The storm reads as wound fibres round a lower eye; left side still terraced, dark field still lumps. Line (i) 17.499

w13b at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: w12b with the fine colour map of MAIL 1422 item 3 (the picture's detail as colour on the code's tops). Reads as painted pillows; the storm gains its fibres. Line (i) 17.557
w12b at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: the same tops rounder and softer, less warp. Reads as a field of soft cloud pillows; storm rings and eye still wrong. Line (i) 17.275
w12 at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: round tops as the surface itself (one dome to a cell, octaves riding), no balls. Dark thirds dark by shade for the first time; reads as rock. Line (i) 17.964
w11 at 3150, preview, draft, no scaffold: packed dim balls in the dark field. Refused: nuggets strewn over wax. Line (i) 18.680

State for MAIL 1413, frame 3150, preview, draft: this state with three solve rounds (top left), main (top right), approved (bottom). Line (i) 7.873 against main 3.390 at the same tier: red. Bands green
State for MAIL 1413, frame 3200, preview, draft: this state (left) beside main (right). Storm rings read as contour lines with a pit for an eye; right third is blue cloth
State for MAIL 1413, frame 3100, preview, draft: this state (left) beside main (right). Worse than main to my eye: cloth folds and popcorn clusters, no dark deep
w8 with the scaffold, three rounds at the fine cut, 3150 preview draft: line (i) 7.873, outside the seven cells 6.606, bands green. Bottom row still 20 too bright at the matter's floor 0.04
w9 3150 preview draft, scaffold off: clusters take the place's light, shade tinted by the orders of scattering. Refused by me: crumbs on marble, too red
w8 3150 preview draft, scaffold off: clusters smaller, sunk, none in the shear. Still silk with popcorn; line (i) 18.635
w7 3150 preview draft, scaffold off: low deck, threads along the flow, clusters with their own colour. Refused by me: white popcorn on dark silk, eye a black pit
3150 preview draft, variant w4 with the scaffold at the fine cut 0.02 units, round 3: line (i) 8.280 whole, 16.378 inside the seven cells, 6.563 outside, floor 0.04
3150 preview draft, variant w6, towers of 0.16 units in the dark thirds, funnel 0.3 deep, scaffold off: reads as rubble and the eye is a black pit, line (i) 16.114, refused
3150 preview draft, variant w5, billows laid in the middle age and three times taller in the dark thirds, scaffold off: reads as mountains, line (i) 15.067, refused

w4 at 3150, preview, draft, scaffold off, floor 0.03: tall relief where the guide is dark. Line (i) 15.297 whole frame, bands green. Wrong: the dark thirds read as draped ridges, not as fine billows with lit rims; right third too bright by 9 to 29

w1 at 3150, preview draft, no scaffold: cloud tops as bodies of density in space, the storm wound from signed sheets, balls laid on the ground. Faults I see: stripes too hard and regular, puffs read as pasted on, right half not dark enough
